subject: general
question: The book "Gita Rahasya", a philosophical interpretation of the Bhagavad Gita, was written by which of the following leaders?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Bal Gangadhar Tilak**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gita Rahasya**, also known as **Srimad Bhagavad Gita Rahasya**, is a famous philosophical interpretation of the **Bhagavad Gita**.
 
• It was written by **Bal Gangadhar Tilak**, a prominent freedom fighter, social reformer, and nationalist leader during the Indian independence movement.
 
• Tilak wrote this book while he was imprisoned in the **Mandalay jail** (Burma) during the years **1908-1914**.
 
• In the book, Tilak emphasizes the concept of **Karma Yoga**, which highlights the importance of performing one's duty selflessly without attachment to the results.
 
• Tilak believed that the Bhagavad Gita was not merely a religious text but a guide for active participation in life and society.
 
• He used the teachings of the Gita to inspire Indians to fight for their rights and freedom during the colonial period.
 
• The book is written in **Marathi** and has been translated into various other languages over time.
 
• Tilak was often referred to as the "**Lion of Maharashtra**" for his bold stance against British rule and his advocacy for Swaraj (self-rule).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Gopal Krishna Gokhale**__

 __
 
• Gopal Krishna Gokhale was a renowned **social reformer and moderate leader** in the Indian National Congress.
 
• He was the founder of the **Servants of India Society**, which aimed to promote education and social welfare.
 
• Gokhale was a mentor to **Mahatma Gandhi** and played a key role in shaping Gandhi's early political views.
 
• Despite his contributions to India's freedom struggle, he did not write Gita Rahasya.
 
 
 
• **Mahatma Gandhi**__
 __
 
• Mahatma Gandhi is known as the "**Father of the Nation**" in India for his pivotal role in the freedom struggle.
 
• Gandhi's philosophy was centered around **non-violence (Ahimsa)** and **truth (Satya)**.
 
• He authored several books, including **Hind Swaraj**, but he did not write Gita Rahasya.
 
 
 
• **Aurobindo Ghosh**__
 
 
• Aurobindo Ghosh was a revolutionary turned spiritual leader who founded the **Aurobindo Ashram** in Pondicherry.
 
• His writings on the Bhagavad Gita focus on its spiritual and metaphysical aspects, particularly in his work **Essays on the Gita**.
 
• However, he was not the author of Gita Rahasya.
